thread:
alex: Heads up — postmortem follow-up for the GPU autoscale saturation yesterday. I'm compiling action items; need owners + ETA. Short thread, please.
jia: I can take scheduler tuning (reduce scale-down aggressiveness + adjust threshold). Will propose patch.
sam: I'll own quota request with cloud account team. ETA EOD Wed if no blockers.
marta: I'll do headroom plan — run a capacity projection + recommend buffer per-region. Need baseline metrics.
luis: I'll run the recurring incident pattern analysis (last 6 weeks) and surface hot signatures. ETA Fri.
alex: Great. Summit: assign IDs: A1 scheduler-tuning (jia), A2 quota-request (sam), A3 headroom-plan (marta), A4 incident-patterns (luis). Add approximate timelines.
jia: Plan for A1: change scheduler config -> prefer scale-up faster, scale-down delay 5m, patch + canary. Draft config: 
```yaml
scale_down_delay: 300
scale_up_threshold: 0.75
scale_down_threshold: 0.25
scheduler_policy: conservative
```
Will open PR today.
sam: For A2: cloud quota request needs SKU list + expected peak GPU hours. I'll post numbers after I pull usage from last 14 days.
marta: A3 approach — propose 20% headroom for US-west, 15% for EU, 10% APAC for now. Will validate with load test.
luis: A4 notes — recurring spike aligns with nightly batch jobs + model retrain window. Suggest rate-limiting those jobs or moving to off-peak.
alex: Also add A5 — add alerting for early headroom breach at 70% cluster utilization (ops-bot can add).
ops-bot: @here New alert created: cluster_utilization_early_warning threshold=0.7; notif=eng-oncall,eng-platform.
marta: Can we add a weekly 30m follow-up sync? propose Thursdays 10am PT. I can host first 2.
alex: thumbs-up. Action check: owners post PRs/issues in the incident tracker. I'll collate into the postmortem doc and set deadlines.
jia: PR opened: #3214 — scheduler tunables. canary rolling now.
sam: Quota request submitted to cloud console, ticket 987654, estimated approval 3-5 business days.
luis: Analysis doc uploaded: link: https://internal/redwood/reports/gpu-incident-patterns-1809
alex: Thanks all. We'll recheck next Thu. Marking thread closed for now; reopen if blockers.
